title: Ship checkout retry with the timeout mismatch unfixed
problem: The code waits 45 seconds between retries where the spec says 30, and only a waiver lets the feature ship this week.
brief: The mismatch is harmless for shoppers but makes the spec wrong. Fixing it means another implementation pass.

solutions.label: Change the code to 30 seconds before shipping
solutions.summary: One constant changes and the gate re-runs; the spec stays true.

cost.work: One code change and a Gate C re-run.

solutions.label: Ship as is and record the waiver
solutions.summary: The feature ships now; the spec is corrected to 45 seconds afterwards.

cost.risk: The spec is wrong until then.
